Name: CustomQuestExpiration
Author: hawkfalcon
Description:
[size=6][b][color=#f1c232]Custom Quest Expiration
[/color][/b][/size]
You can now customization the Daily Quest/Help Wanted Quest expiration time!

[b][color=#f1c232][size=4][u]Features[/u][/size][/color][/b]
[b][color=#6aa84f]Make Daily Quests never expire[/color]
[/b]Never worry about running out of time to finish daily quests 

[b][color=#6aa84f]Adjust the expiration time
[/color][/b]Set it to any amount of days, such as 5, or whatever
Change the expiration time based on the quest type
[list]
[*]ItemDelivery
[*]Gathering
[*]Fishing
[*]SlayMonsters
[/list]
[color=#f1c232][size=4][b][u]Configure[/u][/b][/size][/color]
Fully configurable, see config.yml. 

"NeverExpires": false, # make quests never expire
"DaysToExpiration": 3, # make quests expire after number of days
"UsesQuestCategoryExpiration": true, # use per category expiration instead
"CategoryExpiration": { # per category expiration
    "ItemDelivery": 3,
    "Gathering": 3,
    "Fishing": 2,
    "SlayMonsters": 4
}

[color=#f1c232][size=4][b][u]Future[/u][/b][/size][/color]
Requests? Leave a comment!


[b]**Requires [url=https://smapi.io/]the latest version of SMAPI[/url][color=#f1f1f1] and SDV 1.3 beta**[/color][/b]
﻿Feel free to [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Community#Discord]Chat on Discord[/url] if you have any issues or ideas!
